body:
## Why

The pure report (`groomBoard`, a sibling) and the board read that feeds it (`fetchBoard(ctx, {blockers: 'all'})`,
another sibling) are useless without a way to run them. This task is the verb: one read, zero writes, a stable
`--json` shape and a human format a person can scan.

The token argument is the whole point of the output design. Today learning the state of the triage lane means
~78 KB of JSON, 58 KB of it issue bodies. The report plus only the flagged cards' bodies is roughly 10 KB + 28 KB.
A card nobody needs to judge must carry no `bodyText` at all.

## What

Per #191's *What* section 1 (the CLI half), amended:

- **`hkb groom`** in `src/cli.js`: one `fetchBoard(ctx, { includeClosed: !!flags.all, blockers: 'all' })`, then
  `groomBoard`. Flags: `--status triage,todo,ready` (default those three), `--all`, `--pairs N`,
  `--level act|ask|info`, `--bodies flagged|all|none` (default `flagged`), `--json`. **It writes nothing.**
- **The `--json` shape is exactly the one #191 specifies and is frozen.** `bodyText` appears only when
  `needs_judgment` is true, or under `--bodies all`.
- **Human output**: a header (`26 open · 21 triage · hubs: src/model.js (12), …`), one row per card in
  `taskLine` style ending `⇒ <proposal>` plus the evidence, a `pairs` block, and a footer counting act/ask/info.
- **`hkb list` gains ` ⇡ unblocked`** on a triage card whose (>= 1) blockers are all done — computed in memory
  in `taskLine`, no new field, no write.
- Unknown `--level` / `--bodies` values exit 2 naming the valid list, per the error rule.

## Done when

- [ ] `hkb groom --json` on the fake-gh double makes exactly **one** GraphQL call and **zero** writes.
- [ ] `hkb groom` prints one line per card; `--level x` exits 2 naming the list.
- [ ] A test asserts unflagged cards carry no `bodyText`, and that the `--json` keys are the frozen set.
- [ ] `hkb list` shows ` ⇡ unblocked` on a qualifying triage card, computed in memory.
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test` pass. `skills/kanban/SKILL.md` is **not** touched by this task — the procedure
      is a sibling's.

## Contract

These are the names, signatures and rules a sibling depends on. Do not invent alternatives; a change here
breaks a task you cannot see.

- **The eleven "Amendments from the adversarial pass" at the top of #191 override its body wherever they
  differ.** Read `hkb show 191` first and treat the amendments as the specification. In particular: reuse
  `computeReady`, `agentsOf` and the walk in `src/track.js` — **do not write `detectCycles`**; `no_goal` is
  `info` when the body already has a Done-when heading; `broad_path` exists and is `ask`; `overlap_pair.why` is
  guard-aware.
- `groomBoard(tasks, { now, caps, pairs = 10, statuses })` is exported from `src/model.js` and takes the raw
  `fetchBoard` array and nothing else — a later card puts the same function behind `hkb serve`'s snapshot.
- `GROOM_KINDS` and `GROOM_ACTIONS` are exported from `src/model.js`. Actions are the closed vocabulary
  `promote · specify · link-under · split · supersede · reprioritise · park · archive`, plus `judge` and `none`.
- `fetchBoard(ctx, { blockers: 'all' })` REST-fills blockers for **every open card** on a repo without GraphQL
  `blockedBy`; `blockers: true` keeps today's todo/blocked-only behaviour.
- The `--json` field names in #191 are **frozen**; later kinds are added to `findings`, never renamed.
- The CLI never emits the word "duplicate". `overlap_pair.why` is "will serialize under path_overlap".
- **`src/dispatch.js` is untouched by this whole track** — the promote step still filters `status === 'todo'`.
- Nothing in this track writes to the board. `hkb groom` is a read, like `hkb dispatch --dry-run`.
goal: hkb groom makes one GraphQL call and zero writes, prints one row per card ending in its proposal, emits the frozen --json shape carrying bodyText only for cards needing judgment, exits 2 on an unknown --level/--bodies, and hkb list shows the unblocked nudge computed in memory
title: hkb groom: the read verb, its frozen JSON shape, and the unblocked nudge in hkb list
